consequence.statement: The `--registry` flag no longer sets a default registry. Packages without a registry host name in their reference (such as `crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v1.23.0`) are no longer resolved against a default registry.
consequence.remediation: Run `kubectl get pkg -o wide` and update any package without a registry host name to a fully qualified name, such as `xpkg.crossplane.io/crossplane-contrib/provider-aws-s3:v1.23.0`, before upgrading.

assertion.statement: The `--registry` flag for the default package registry is removed, so all packages must use fully qualified names that include the registry host.
